# Exploración Datos {menu-title="Exploración Datos - Visualización Ptal"}

::: {.subtitle}
Visualización Ptal durante el dia
:::
```{python}
#| echo: false

import json
from pathlib import Path

# =========================================================
# Rutas
# =========================================================
main_path = Path.cwd().resolve()
folder_ptal = main_path / "Data" / "Data Ptal"

# =========================================================
# Obtener archivos GeoJSON
# =========================================================
archivos = sorted(
    [f.name for f in folder_ptal.glob("*.geojson")]
)

# =========================================================
# Crear index.json
# =========================================================
with open(folder_ptal / "index.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(
        archivos,
        f,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=4
    )

```

```{=html}
<iframe 
  id="ptal"
  class="map-ptal"
  src="Html/ptal_viewer/map_ptal.html" 
  width="100%" 
  height="640px" 
  style="border: none;">
</iframe>

<script>
const iframeptal = document.getElementById("ptal");

iframeptal.addEventListener("load", () => {
  setTimeout(() => {

    iframeptal.contentWindow.postMessage({
      areas: {
        "Área baja conectividad": "../../Data/Area Baja/area_seleccionada.json",
        "Área intermedia conectividad": "../../Data/Area Intermedia/area_seleccionada.json",
        "Área alta conectividad": "../../Data/Area Alta/area_seleccionada.json",
      }
    }, "*");

  }, 100);
});
</script>
```
